youtube_title: Waitlisted Train Ticket After the Chart: Board or Not? Rules You Didn't Know #15 #Shorts
youtube_description:
RULES YOU DIDN'T KNOW #15. Your online train ticket is still waitlisted and the chart is out. A: board, the TTE will adjust. B: don't board, take the refund.
Answer: B. A fully waitlisted e-ticket is dropped from the chart and cancelled automatically, and the refund goes back to the account you booked with, minus a small clerkage. No counter visit needed. Travelling in a sleeper or AC coach on a waitlisted ticket can get you fined and moved to the general coach.
Source: Indian Railways refund rules 2015 + Railways enforcement on waitlisted passengers (May 2025).
